items.title: datasette-leaflet 0.3
items.summary:
Release: datasette-leaflet 0.3
        OpenStreetMap have a very reasonable policy that hits to their hosted tile server should send a referrer header. Datasette table pages used the Referrer-Policy: no-referrer HTTP header, causing plugins that loaded tiles from OpenStreetMap to violate that policy.
datasette-leaflet is the plugin that loads a bundled Leaflet so other Datasette plugins can depend on it. It now sets the referrer policy on the tile requests themselves to strict-origin-when-cross-origin, passing the host but not the full path to the page.
    
    
        Tags: leaflet, dataset

items.title: OpenAI posts a record $10B+ quarter and finally gets a growth story back
items.summary: Business: Q3 revenue rose 50% from Q2, after Q2 growth of only 17% compared with Anthropic's 144%. The drivers were API demand for recent models, including GPT-6 Astra, quietly strong image-model demand, and ads running at a $1 billion annualized pace. Operating losses grew to an estimated $10.1–10.9 billion, though operating margin improved from −150% to −109%.

items.summary: Models: Watching was always the slowest part of editing. Now you can ask a model to find the three onboarding complaints across twenty hours of calls.
